text:
Lina: Quick follow-up thread for Nimbus Labs private deployment postmortem. Root cause still the asymmetric route + on-prem firewall state that intermittently dropped KV-cache restore traffic. We need clear owners, deadlines, and at least one automated regression test. Short list of remediation buckets below.

Marco: I can own the VPC peering config changes (route / ASN alignment) and coordinate with Nimbus NIC. Will request maintenance window. Target: 2026-04-12 for config change + verification.

Priya: I'll handle the on-prem kernel/module mismatch patch and work with their infra team for a staged rollout. Need their approval for reboot windows. Tentative ETA: 2026-04-15.

Tara: I'll take the runbook and smoke test work (includes a peering health probe and KV-cache replay validation). Plan: add a nightly run that simulates prefix announcements and validates state recovery.

Javi: I'll update alerts and add a dedicated SLI for 'peering stability' (5m windows + rapid-fire alerts) and a dashboard tile for prefix flaps. Will also wire in automated paging to oncall.

OpsBot: Weekly check-in scheduled every Tue 10:00 UTC until all actions closed. First check-in: 2026-03-31. (use `@OpsBot subscribe` to join).

Lina: Action items (short) -- please ack and comment if you need a different ETA.
- A1: Reconcile Nimbus ASN/routes + announce policy (owner: Marco) — due 2026-04-12 — test: BGP adj stable for 24h
- A2: Kernel/module alignment + reboot plan for onprem nodes (owner: Priya) — due 2026-04-15 — test: KV restore across reboots
- A3: Peering smoke test + replay harness (owner: Tara) — due 2026-04-09 — test: nightly smoke pass for 7 days
- A4: Alerts/dashboard + SLI (owner: Javi) — due 2026-04-06 — test: alert fires on artificial flap
- A5: Update isolation runbook + escalation matrix (owner: Tara) — due 2026-04-09

Marco: Posting the quick verification commands I'll use for Nimbus NIC during initial validation:```bash
# check BGP neighbors and routes
vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary" -c "show ip route 203.0.113.0/24"
# conntrack check on their edge box
sudo conntrack -L | grep 203.0.113.45
```

Priya: For the kernel mismatch, our patch is small (netfilter backport). I'll publish a patch branch and include an ansible playbook for their infra. Example check:```yaml
- name: ensure kernel module
  ansible.builtin.shell: lsmod | grep nft_chain
```

Tara: Smoke test prototype (local):```bash
curl -fsS http://peering-health.internal/health || echo "peering-fail"
# KV replay sanity
python tools/kv_replay_check.py --target nimbus --keys sample_prefix --timeout 30
```

Javi: I'll add a synthetic that flips a pref then watches for failed restores, plus a PagerDuty integration for severity>1.

Lina: Risk notes: 1) Nimbus has strict maintenance windows (weekdays 01:00-05:00 local) — coordinate early. 2) Onprem firewalls may not preserve conntrack for asymmetric flows; the smoke test needs to exercise both directions.

Marco: Ack, coordinating with Nimbus ops; will request a holdback control plane snapshot before any config change.

Priya: Ack. I'll post the patch PR and rollout playbook to the postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/nimbus-peering-2026 and tag everyone.

Tara: Acknowledged. I'll create the test CI job under infra-ci/peering-smoke and wire results to the incidents dashboard.

Javi: Acked. Will push dashboard tiles and add an alert runbook step.

Lina: Thanks everyone. OpsBot will remind us before weekly check-ins. Please update the postmortem doc with links to PRs and CI jobs as you create them. Closing note: try to keep changes minimal and prefixed with a rollback plan. :white_check_mark:

OpsBot: Reminder created — recurring check-ins every Tue 10:00 UTC. Use `@OpsBot reschedule` to change. :spiral_calendar:
